music-mindfulness-01.draft: soft ambient pads for coming back to the room when your head has run off without you

music-mindfulness-04.draft: a long, mellow jazz meditation for slowing down and paying attention to small things

music-mindfulness-07.draft: gentle ambient with running water for settling back into your body

music-mindfulness-10.draft: a steady meditation track for sitting still when everything feels too fast

music-mindfulness-10.why: The steady, resonant hum and lack of sudden shifts provide an unobtrusive backdrop for tuning into present-moment awareness.

music-mindfulness-11.draft: a twenty-minute spacious ambient sit for when you want a long, unhurried pause
